title: Stop Using AI Like a Search Bar
description:
Most people use AI at level 1.

They chat with it.

That’s useful… but it’s only the beginning.

There are 3 levels of AI use:

1️⃣ Chat
2️⃣ Automation
3️⃣ Agents

Chat helps you think faster.
Automation helps you save time.
Agents help you delegate entire tasks.

The mistake is thinking AI is just “asking questions”.

The real opportunity is building systems that work with you.

🚀 You’ll find free access to our AI class in our profile.
